## Risk review entry — 30 September 2026

Instrument: iShares USD Treasury Bond 7–10yr UCITS ETF\
Account exposure: 9.26%\
Account limit: 9.00%\
Assessment: Breach indicated — 0.26 percentage points above limit.

The September 2026 BlackRock fund factsheets support a combined direct long exposure of 9.26% of the model account to the named ETF, based on the stated 40% allocation to MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund and 60% allocation to MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund.

### Supporting calculation

| Fund               | Account weight | Direct ETF holding | Account contribution |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| MyMap 3 Select ESG | 40.00%         | 9.95%              | 3.98%                |
| MyMap 5 Select ESG | 60.00%         | 8.80%              | 5.28%                |
| Total              | 100.00%        |                    | 9.26%                |

\\[ (40\\%\times9.95\\%)+(60\\%\times8.80\\%) =3.98\\%+5.28\\%=\boxed{9.26\\%} \\]

The calculated excess is 9.26% − 9.00% = 0.26 percentage points, using the holding percentages at their printed precision.

### Documents, pages and dates

1\. MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund — September 2026 factsheet

Class S Acc British Pound. Page 1 identifies 30 September 2026 as the portfolio-breakdown date (other data: 9 October 2026). Page 3, Top 10 Holdings, records `ISHS $ TSY BOND 7-10YR UCITS ETF` at 9.95%.

2\. MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund — September 2026 factsheet

Class X Acc British Pound. Page 1 specifies the same reporting dates. Page 3, Top 10 Holdings, records the ETF at 8.80%.

3\. BlackRock Investment Funds — Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements

For the financial year ended 28 February 2025. The Portfolio Statements identify the ETF by its full name and report historical holdings of 13.42% for MyMap 3 Select ESG (printed page 251; PDF page 252) and 2.28% for MyMap 5 Select ESG (printed page 316; PDF page 317). These earlier figures are not used in the September 2026 calculation. 

BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.pdf



### Reviewer conclusion

The records support recording an apparent limit breach as at 30 September 2026, based on the reported direct long holdings. The calculation excludes other Treasury ETFs, derivatives and indirect underlying bond exposures.

The September 2026 evidence consists of fund marketing factsheets rather than audited holdings records. Accordingly, the reviewer can conclude that the published exposure exceeds the prescribed limit, while noting that independent position-level confirmation would be needed for a formally reconciled compliance determination.
